lead: Newest clear Sentinel-2 pass over BWMA, accepted into the current report on Nov 13, 2026. The acreage is the Estimate after this scene (it added 7.12 ac), not a single-scene measurement. It also includes official correction #4 (Nov 16, 2026; +2.57 ac in the West Winterton north arm).
method_details: The scene passed the cloud screen (counted-unit cloud and shadow at or below 20%) and was added to the cumulative inventory under the existing rules: open water where Sentinel-2 NIR is below 0.16, plus radar flooded vegetation, with patch-size and connection checks. Only new area outside the existing footprint is added. Drew and East Winterton are not counted.
cloud_rule: Counted-unit cloud and shadow at or below 20%.
date_line: Scene date 2026-11-11 · Sentinel-2 · 0% cloud over BWMA · Estimate as of this scene
